rw.name: Brian Robinson
rw.head: Gets into end zone in win
rw.blurb: Robinson rushed 10 times for 50 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 54 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

rw.name: Michael Penix
rw.head: Stellar in season debut
rw.blurb: Penix completed 18 of 25 passes for 256 yards with one touchdown and one interception while rushing twice for minus-2 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.

rw.name: Jordan Love
rw.head: Fantasy-friendly numbers in loss
rw.blurb: Love completed 28 of 53 passes for 312 yards with two touchdowns and one interception and rushed once for no gain in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday. He also committed a fumble recovered by Green Bay.

rw.name: Matthew Golden
rw.head: Hits century mark in loss
rw.blurb: Golden brought in five of 12 targets for 100 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday.

rw.name: Christian Watson
